title: Жареный тартар и две девушки  (Fried Tartare and Two Girls)

scenes.title: Max's Nightmare and the Returned Tartare
scenes.summary: Max wakes up from a nightmare about Vika and Sasha, and at the restaurant a demanding guest sends back Chef Barinov's steak tartare asking for it to be fried.

scenes.title: The Guest Is Always Right
scenes.summary: Vika reminds Chef Barinov that the customer is always right while Barinov refuses to fry raw tartare, and Max tells Kostya he is relieved thinking Sasha flew to Cyprus.

scenes.title: Only Idiots Fry Tartare
scenes.summary: Max complains to Kostya that he cannot choose between Vika and Sasha, while Chef Barinov lectures Lyova that only idiots fry raw steak tartare.

scenes.title: The Famous Footballer's Wife
scenes.summary: Vika informs Chef Barinov that the guest demanding fried tartare is the wife of a famous footballer, prompting the football-obsessed Chef to try guessing which player.

scenes.title: The Invented Death of a Grandfather
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov gladly fries the tartare thinking the guest's husband plays for Spartak, and Max lies to Vika that he skipped Cyprus because Kostya's grandfather died.

scenes.title: Condolences to Kostya
scenes.summary: Vika offers her condolences to a bewildered Kostya at the bar, and then warmly tells Max she wants them to start over from the beginning.

scenes.title: The Success of the Fried Tartare
scenes.summary: Kostya covers for Max's lie when Vika checks on him, and Vika informs Chef Barinov that the footballer's wife loved the fried tartare and ordered a second portion.

scenes.title: Sasha Never Flew Away
scenes.summary: Max is stunned when Sasha shows up at the restaurant having skipped Cyprus to stay with him, forcing him to invent another lie about Kostya's dog dying to avoid her tonight.

scenes.title: A Grandfather or a Dog Named Grandpa
scenes.summary: Sasha and Vika compare notes about Kostya's tragedy in front of him, forcing Kostya to improvise that his late dog was nicknamed 'Grandpa'.

scenes.title: Malafeev Instead of Makeev
scenes.summary: Vika introduces Chef Barinov to the guest in the dining room, where Barinov discovers to his horror that he has been feeding Zenit goalkeeper Vyacheslav Malafeev instead of a Spartak player.

scenes.title: Sabotage in the Name of Spartak
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov decides he must help his beloved club by giving Zenit's goalkeeper mild food poisoning before tomorrow's match, ignoring Lyova's protests.

scenes.title: Max Eats the Spiked Dish
scenes.summary: Malafeev politely declines the sour-tasting complimentary dish, and a hungry Max unknowingly devours it in the kitchen and collapses with severe stomach cramps.

scenes.title: The Call from the Hospital
scenes.summary: Taken to the hospital with food poisoning, Max has a fellow patient tell Vika on the phone that he went missing, only to realize he accidentally pulled the prank on Sasha instead.

scenes.title: The Stomach Pump and the Chef's Remorse
scenes.summary: A strict nurse interrupts Max's call with Kostya for a medical procedure, while back at the restaurant Chef Barinov feels guilty thinking he hospitalized Malafeev.

scenes.title: Sasha Visits Max in the Ward
scenes.summary: Lyova convinces Chef Barinov that poisoning people for football is wrong, and Sasha surprises Max in his hospital bed after asking Kostya which hospital he was in.

scenes.title: Vika's Visit to the Hospital
scenes.summary: Malafeev returns to the restaurant completely unharmed, and at the hospital Vika arrives to visit Max while Sasha is waiting inside his ward.

scenes.title: The Decoy Hospital Room Trick
scenes.summary: Knowing Sasha is inside his real ward, Max leads Vika into an empty neighboring room while frantically calling Kostya for letting both girls find out where he was.

scenes.title: Double Exposure at the Hospital
scenes.summary: The real occupant of the decoy hospital bed returns and kicks Max out, causing Vika and Sasha to run into each other in Max's real ward and discover his double game.

scenes.title: Losing Both Girls and Asking for Work
scenes.summary: Both Vika and Sasha dump Max on the spot at the hospital, and a miserable Max returns to the kitchen begging Chef Barinov to bury him in work with no days off.
